_doc: TPCR-TWEET-RESTYLE-CUTOVER: the ONLY place the format window and the new-format reply tiers are set. reply_tier_a/reply_tier_b: |observed - forecast| WTI cutoffs, set by Fred Oct 28 2026 to A=3.0, B=6.0 (miss <= A ✅, A < miss <= B ⬇️/⬆️, > B ⏬/⏫; unset or invalid = new-format reply skipped_bad_config). Read by operations/scripts/tweet_format.py. Times are America/New_York (EDT, UTC-4, on both dates; DST ends 02:00 Nov 1, after old_retires). discord_cta (TPCR-DISCORD-GROWTH-001, Fred Nov 18 2026): a SEPARATE text-only reply 'Free daily forecasts live on our Discord: <invite_url>' threaded under the 8:30 AM OBSERVED post (the OBSERVED and FORECAST texts never change). Two gates, both required: env TPCR_DISCORD_CTA_REPLY=1 AND this block. invite_url = the x-daily Discord invite, https://discord.gg/<code> (code ^[A-Za-z0-9-]{2,32}$; null, INVITE*/placeholder/example/xxx/x-daily codes are skipped with a logged reason; Fred supplied https://discord.gg/2Estr7sbP7 on Nov 19 2026, never expires, and it is set on the Mini at enable, not in this committed file); first_post_date/last_post_date = America/Toronto posting dates (the day the reply goes out, not park day D), YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive, last = first + 13 days (14 posts, max). Set by the chief at the Mini deploy once Fred supplies the real invite. All null = off; partial or invalid = off plus one ERROR on stderr. After last_post_date it stops on its own.
